; All patterns: UpdateRateHz controls requested scans/s and logical scan duration (1 / UpdateRateHz).
; Optional WEATHERDATA producer list, matching the regular Lidar plugin.
; RT Lidar test scene: two stationary sensors, a visualizer and an OSI logger.
; Numeric Lidar parameters must be finite (no NaN or Infinity).
; Like regular Lidar, the manager shares the latest weather with all its sensors.
; When bWeatherEffectEnabled is true in WEATHERDATA, apply the regular Lidar range degradation
; Logical scan duration is always 1 / UpdateRateHz (here 0.05 s, maximum 60 s).
; Derived logical duration: 1 / UpdateRateHz = 0.1 s; at most one scan per game frame.
; Display the camera image from a CameraSensorView: true | false; no effect for Lidar.
; Mount target for the visualizer camera: producer/object name resolved as a mount
; target by an active manager. Empty = unmounted camera using the world positions below.
; Do not use Lidar producers here: they provide SensorView, not TrafficUpdate.
; Camera X in cm, forward; relative to Mount if set, otherwise a world position.
; Camera Y in cm, right; same reference frame and limits as X.
; Camera Z in cm, up; same reference frame and limits as X.
; Camera pitch in degrees; negative values look down. No explicit parser limit;
; Camera rotation around Z in degrees; positive values turn towards +Y.
; Data type for each Input: SensorView | SensorData. RT Lidar provides SensorView.
;If available, show camera in viewport (overlay bottom right)
